description_en: Retrieves information about a specified AI agent instance
name: DescribeAIAgentInstance

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the AI agent instance.

> The `InstanceId` is the unique ID returned when an AI agent instance starts successfully. For APIs that start an AI agent, see [StartAIAgentInstance](~~2846201~~) and [GenerateAIAgentCall](~~2846209~~).
parameters.description_zh:
智能体实例ID。

> InstanceId为智能体实例启动成功后，返回的唯一的Id。启动智能体接口，请参见[StartAIAgentInstance ](~~2846201~~)、[GenerateAIAgentCall](~~2846209~~)。
